name: Ajou Global Scholarship

conditional_alternative.condition: Applicant is from an English mother-tongue country
conditional_alternative.evidence: Certificate of higher education with English as medium of instruction

language_requirements.interpretation_note: One accepted test alternative is sufficient for the language condition. Do not require every listed test. Country-group assignment must be checked, not inferred from test language.

excluded_department_note: Excluded students follow their respective departmental scholarship systems; this does not mean no funding is available.

teaching_assistant_duties.source_scope: Admitted full-time international students belonging to College of Engineering and Department of Computer Engineering
